key_decisions.decision: Retain the violence and discretionary action without inserting a limiting defense formula not present in this verse.
Retain the second three names in their source order.
Retain the four concluding names, keeping Arisai and Aridai distinct.
Complete the list’s identification and preserve the first of three explicit refusals to plunder.
Preserve Esther’s request for another day and postmortem display; do not soften or justify it.
Retain the second day’s date and count and repeat the no-plunder refrain.
Keep the defensive framing, large stated death toll, and third no-plunder refrain without harmonizing the figure.
Render the ambiguous feminine coming-clause as the matter’s arrival, with Esther as an alternative in the note; keep the summary’s compressed chronology.
Follow the plural reading tradition and preserve the obligation’s extension to descendants and new adherents.
Retain the switch to a masculine singular sender and the province count; render truth as reliable assurance in this letter’s greeting.
